data.titulo: Ekicweka 6—Okuruga ha Kuzaarwa kwa Yesu Kuhika ha Kufa kwe
data.contenido:
Maraika Gabiryeri akatumwa hali omwisiki omurungi kandi omuto ayayetwaga Malyamu. Akamugambira nkoku akaba naija kutunga omwana owakaba naija kulema nk’omukama ebiro byona. Omwana ogu Yesu, akazaalirwa mukiiraro ky’ente, ei abaliisa b’entaama bamubungiire. Hanyumaho, enyunyuzi ekebembera abasaija kuruga Buruga-izooba kubahikya hali omwana omuto. Nitwega hali ogu eyabasobozeseze kurora enyunyuzi, kandi nkoku Yesu yakiziibwe kuruga hali abo abaali nibenda kumwita.

Ekindi, nitusanga Yesu obu akaba aine emyaka 12 y’obukuru, nabaza nabegesa omu yekaru. Emyaka ikumi na munaana obu yahingwireho, Yesu akabatizibwa yatandika kukora omulimu Ruhanga ogu yamutumire kukora mu nsi; nigwo ogw’okutebeza n’okwegesa ha Bukama bwe. Yesu akakoma abasaija 12 kumukonyera mu mulimo gunu, kandi yabafoora abakwenda be.

Yesu akakora n’ebyamahano bingi. Akaliisa enkumi z’abantu n’obucu butaito n’emigaati mitaito. Akakiza abarwaire kandi yahumbura abafu. Mu kumalirra, nitwega ha bintu bingi ebyahikire hali Yesu ha kiro ekyasembereyo mu bwomezi bwe, n’oku yaisirwe. Yesu akatebeza kumara nk’emyaka esatu n’ekicweka, kale EKICWEKA 6 nikitwara obusumi obukuhingura mu myaka 34.

OMUKAZI onu arukuzooka kurungi nuwe Malyamu. Mukazi Muisareri arukwikara mu rubuga rwa Nazalesi. Ruhanga nakimanya ngu muntu murungi muno. Nikyo atwekiire maraika we Gabiryeri aije abaze nawe. Omanyire Gabiryeri eki yaizire kumugambira? Katurole.

Gabiryeri amugamba ati: ‘Mirembe iwe anyakuhairwe muno omugisa, Yahwe ali naiwe.’ Malyamu akaba atakarorahoga omuntu onu. Akahunirra habwokuba tarayetegerize maraika eki arukumanyisa. Baitu ahonaho yamugamba atekanane.

Yamugamba: ‘Otatiina Malyamu, oboine embabazi hali Yahwe nikyo arukwija kukukorra ekintu ekyamahano. Oija kutunga omwana. Oyine kumweta Yesu.’

Gabiryeri ayeyongera kusoborra: ‘Aliba mukuru kandi alyetwa omwana wa Ruhanga anyakuli Haiguru Muno. Yahwe alimufora omukama, nkoku Daudi akaba ali. Baitu Yesu aliba Mukama ebiro byona, kandi obukama bwe tibulihwaho!’

Malyamu amukaguza ati: ‘Ebi byona birisoboka bita? Tinswirwe. Tindikwikara n’omusaija, hati nsobora nta kutunga omwana?’

Gabiryeri amugarukamu ati: ‘Amaani ga Ruhanga galikwizira, n’ahabwekyo omwana alyetwa Mwana wa Ruhanga.’ Ayeyongera agamba Malyamu ati: ‘Ijuka Erisabesi mwene wanyu. Abantu bakagamba nti akuzire muno tasobora kuzaara baana. Baitu mu bwangu aija kutunga omwana w’obwojo. Nahabwekyo norora, tiharoho Ruhanga ekyatasobora kukora.’

Ahonaho Malyamu agamba ati: ‘Ndi muzaana wa Yahwe; kibe hali nyowe nkoku ogambire.’ Hanyuma, maraika agenda.

Malyamu ayanguha kugenda kubungira Erisabesi. Erisabesi obuyahuliire iraka lya Malyamu, omwana munda ya Erisabesi agurukaguruka n’okusemererwa. Erisabesi aijuzibwa omwoyo gwa Ruhanga, kandi agambira Malyamu ati: ‘Ohairwe omugisa omuli abakazi.’ Malyamu aikara na Erisabesi okumara nk’emyezi esatu, hanyuma agaruka owabu Nazalesi.

Malyamu ali haihi okuswerwa omusaija arukwetwa Yusufu. Baitu Yusufu obu yakyetegerize nti Malyamu nagenda kuzaara, atekereza nti tikihikire okumuswera. Nukwo maraika wa Ruhanga kumugambira ati: ‘Otatiina okutwara mukazi wawe Malyamu habwokuba Ruhanga nuwe omuhaire omwana.’ Kale Yusufu atahya Malyamu kandi balindirra Yesu okuzaarwa.Luka 1:26-56; Matayo 1:18-25. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OMANYIRE enkerembe niyo eha? Mali niwe Yesu. Nubwo akaba yakazaarwa mu kiraaro ky’ente. Malyamu nateeka Yesu mu kikwato nambere bateka eby’okulya by’endogoyi n’ebisoro ebindi. Baitu habwaki Malyamu na Yusufu bali hanu n’ebisoro? Gunu tiguli mwanya abaana habazaalirwa. Niho?

Nangwa tihali niho. Enu niyo nsonga habwaki bali hanu: Omukama w’Abarumi Kaisali Agusito akatekaho ekiragiro nti buli muntu aina kugaruka mu rubuga oru yazaalirwemu ibara lye lihandikwe mu kitabu. Yusufu uwe akaba azaalirwe mu Beterehemu. Baitu uwe na Malyamu obu bahikireyo, batasobole kutunga omwanya gw’okuraramu gwona. Nikyo baiziire kuba n’ebisoro. Mu kiro kinu kyonyini, Malyamu yazaara Yesu! Baitu, nkoku okurora, uwe ali kurungi.



Norora abaliisa abaizire kurora Yesu? Bakaba bali omwirisizo nibalinda entaama zabu ekiro, kandi okumulikya okukooto kwabehinguliriza. Akaba ali maraika! Abaliisa bakatiina muno. Baitu maraika yabagamba: ‘Mutatiina, mbaletiire amakuru amarungi. Kiro kinu, mu Beterehemu, Kristo Omukama azairwe. Naija kujuna abantu! Nimwija kumusanga azingirwe mu bugoye kandi abyamire mu kiraaro ky’ente.’ Ahonaho, bamaraika baingi baija kandi batandika kukugiza Ruhanga. Mu bwangu abaliisa banu bayanguha kuserra Yesu, kandi hati bamuzoire.

Omanyire ahabwaki Yesu w’embaganiza y’amaani? Omanyire mali niwe oha? Ijuka, muruganikyo orw’okubanza orw’ekitabu kinu, tukagambaho ha mwana wa Ruhanga omuzigaijo. Omwana onu akakorra hamu na Ruhanga mukukora iguru n’ensi n’ebintu ebindi byoona. Onu nuwe Yesu mali!

Ego, Yahwe akaiha obwomezi bw’Omwana we omu iguru kandi y’abuteeka omunda ya Malyamu. Ahonaho omwana yatandika kukurra munda ye nkoku abaana bakurra munda z’abanyinabo. Baitu onu akaba ali Mwana wa Ruhanga. Mu kumalirra, Yesu yazalirwa mu kiraaro ky’ente mu Beterehemu. Hati norora habwaki bamaraika bakaba basemerirwe muno okugambira abantu nti Yesu akaba azairwe?Luka 2:1-20. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NOSOBORA kurora enyunyuzi erukwaka muno, ei omu h’abasaija banu nambere arukwoleka orukumu? Obu barugire Yerusalemu, enyunyuzi ekeyoleka. Abasaija banu nibaruga Buruga-izooba, kandi nibo betegereza eby’enyunyuzi. Nibaikiriza ngu enyunyuzi enu empyaka nebebembera kubahikya ha muntu ow’ekitiinisa. Abasaija obu bahikire Yerusalemu, bakakaguza bati: ‘Omwana orukwija kuba omukama w’Abayudaya ali nkaha?’ “Abayudaya” ibara rindi ery’Abaisareri. Abasaija bagamba: ‘Tukabanza kurora enyunyuzi y’omwana obu tukaba tuli Buruga-izooba, kandi twizire kumuramya.’

Herode nuwe akaba ali omukama mu Yerusalemu, obu yahulire kinu, akeralikirra. Akaba atarukugonza omukama ondi kutwara omwanya gwe. Herode nikyo yayetiire banyakatagara abakuru kandi akabakaguza ati: ‘Omukama ayanihiziibwe naija kuzaalirwa nkaha?’ Bamugarukamu bati: ‘Baibuli n’egamba mu Beterehemu.’

Herode nukwo kweta abasaija abaarugire Buruga-izoba kandi akabagamba ati: ‘Mugende muserre omwana ogu omuto. Obu muramuzoora, muumanyise. Ninyenda kugenda kumuramya.’ Baitu mananu, Herode akaba nayenda kuzoora omwana nukwo amwite!

Enyunyuzi yayebembera abasaija kubatwara Beterehemu kandi yayemerra mu mwanya omwana nambere aka ali. Abasaija obu bataahire omunju, basanga Malyamu n’omwana Yesu. Basumurra ebisembo n’okubiha Yesu. Hanyuma, Yahwe abarabura mukirooto butagaruka owa Herode. Nahabwekyo bagaruka mu nsi y’owabu nibaraba mumuhanda ogundi.

Herode obu yakimanyire nti abasaija abarugire Buruga-izooba bagarukire owabubo, akabihirwa muno. Akaragira nti abaana b’obwojo mu Beterehemu ab’emyaka ebiri na hansi baitwe. Baitu Yahwe yarabura Yusufu omu kirooto bukyali, kandi Yusufu n’ab’omuka ye bagenda Misiri. Hanyuma, Yusufu obu yakimanyire nti Herode akaba afiire, atwara Malyamu na Yesu Nazalesi. Kunu nuho Yesu yakuliire.

Iwe notekereza noha ayaretiire enyunyuzi egi empyaka okwaka? Ijuka, abasaija bakabanza kugenda Yerusalemu obu bamazire kurora enyunyuzi. Setani Diabolo akaba nagonza kwita Omwana wa Ruhanga, kandi akaba nakimanya ngu Herode omukama wa Yerusalemu yakulengereho kumwita. Kale mali Setani nuwe aine kuba yaletiire enyunyuzi egi okwaka.Matayo 2:1-23; Mika 5:2. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

data.titulo: Yesu obu Akaba Akyali Muto mu Yekaru
data.contenido:
DORA omwojo omuto arukubaza n’abasaija banu abakuru. Begesa ab’omu yekaru ya Ruhanga omu Yerusalemu. Omwojo onu niwe Yesu. Akuzire. Hati ali w’emyaka 12 ey’obukuru.

Abegesa bahunirire muno habwokuba Yesu amanyire bingi ebirukukwata hali Ruhanga n’ebihandikirwe mu Baibuli. Baitu habwaki Yusufu na Malyamu nabo batali hanu? Bakaba bali nkaha? Ka tukyetegereze.

Buli mwaka Yusufu yaletaga ob’omuka ye Yerusalemu kukuza ekiro eky’embaganiza ekirukwetwa Okuhingurwaho. Orugendo ruraira kuruga Nazalesi kuhika Yerusalemu. Busaho anyakwina motoka, kandi tiharoho egaali z’omwika. Binu bikaba bitaroho mu busumi obu. Abantu abakukira obwingi barubataga, kandi kyabatwarraga ebiro bisatu kuhika Yerusalemu.

Mu kasumi kanu, Yusufu aina abantu baingi mu maka ge. Kale haroho bato ba Yesu abasemire kurolererwa. Kale mwaka gunu, Yusufu na Malyamu bali mu muhanda oguraira n’abaana babu nibagaruka Nazalesi. Nibatekereza ngu Yesu narubata n’abantu abandi. Baitu obu bahumwire rwebagyo, Yesu batamurore. Bamuserra mubanyabuzale n’abanywani, baitu akaba atali nabo! Kale bagaruka Yerusalemu nuho kumuserurra.

Hanyuma bazoora Yesu ali hanu n’abegesa. Nabahuliriza kandi nabakaguza ebikaguzo. Kandi abantu boona nibahunirra habw’amagezi Yesu againe. Baitu Malyamu amugamba: ‘Mwana waitu, habwaki otukozere kinu? So nanye tubaire tweralikiriire muno, nitukuserra.’

‘Habwaki mubaire nimunserra?’ Yesu amukaguza. ‘Mubaire mutarukukimanya ngu nsemerire kuba mu nju ya ise nyowe?’

Mali, Yesu nagonza kuba nambere asobora kwega hali Ruhanga. Ekyo tinikyo twakugondeze? Obu yagarukire Nazalesi, yagendaga mu nso’rokano z’okuramya buli wiiki. Habwokuba yahulirizaga kurungi, yayegaga ebintu bingi kuruga omu Baibuli. Tube nka Yesu, tuhondere eky’okurorraho kye.Luka 2:41-52; Matayo 13:53-56. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA eriiba niriija ha mutwe gw’omusaija. Omusaija onu nuwe Yesu. Hati aine haihi emyaka 30 ey’obukuru. Omusaija owali nawe nuwe Yohana. Tukegaho ebimu ebirikumukwataho. Noijuka Malyamu obu yagenzere kubungira omunyabuzale we Erisabesi, kandi nkoku omwana omunda ya Erisabesi yagurukire n’okusemererwa? Omwana ogu owakaba atakazairwe akaba ali Yohana. Baitu hati Yohana na Yesu nibakora ki?

Yohana yakamara kwibika Yesu omumaizi g’Ekisaaru kya Yorudani. Nigwo mulingo omuntu abatizibwamu. Okubanza aibikwa mumaizi, hanyuma naihwamu. Habw’okuba Yohana nakora kinu, nikyo yayetwaga Yohana Omubatizi. Baitu habwaki Yohana yabatiize Yesu?

Mali Yohana akakora kinu habwokuba Yesu akaija kandi yasaba Yohana amubatize. Yohana yabatizaga abantu abakugonza kwoleka ngu begarukiremu habw’ebikorwa ebibi ebi bakaba bakozere. Yesu akaba aine ebikorwa ebibi eby’okwegarukamu? Nangwa, habw’okuba nuwe Mwana wa Ruhanga eyarugire mw’iguru. Kale akasaba Yohana amubatize habw’ensonga ey’embaganiza. Katurore ensonga egyo niyo eraha?

Yesu atakaizire hanu owa Yohana, akaba ali mubaizi. Omubaizi nuwe omuntu akora ebintu nk’emeza n’entebe kuruga mumbaho. Yusufu, iba Malyamu akaba ali mubaizi kandi akegesa Yesu kuba nkawe. Baitu Yahwe atatume Omwana we kwija omu nsi kuba omubaizi. Akaba amwiniire omulimo ogw’embaganiza, kandi obwire hati buhikire Yesu okuhikiriza omulimo ogu. Kale nu, okwoleka nti hati aizire kukora Ise by’agonza, Yesu asaba Yohana amubatize. Kinu Ruhanga akakisiima? Ego, habw’okuba obu yamazire okuruga omumaizi ati, iraka likaruga omu iguru lyagamba: ‘Onu nuwe Mwana wange, ou nsemererwa.’ Kandi kikasisana nti iguru likakingurwa kandi eriiba lyaija hali Yesu. Baitu tiriri eriiba lyonyini. Likaba nirisisana busana nkalyo. Mananu, gwali mwoyo gwa Ruhanga ogurukwera.

Hati, Yesu aine bingi eby’okutekerezaho. Nikyo yagendiire mu mukiikaro nambere akaba nasobora kuba wenka kumara ebiro 40. Oku Setani akamwizira. Emirundi esatu Setani akalengaho kuletera Yesu kukora ekirukucwa ebiragiro bya Ruhanga. Baitu Yesu tasobora kukikora.

Hanyuma yebyo, Yesu agarukayo, kandi atangana abasaija abaafookere bakurasi be rundi abegesebwa be ab’okubanza. Amabara g’abamu nigo Andereya, Petero (obundi ayetwa Simoni), Firipo na Nasaneri (obundi ayetwa Batoromayo). Yesu n’abegeswa be abahyaka bagenda mu kicweka kya Galiraya. Mu Galiraya baikarayo kake mu Kana, orubuga oru Nasaneri nambere akaba naruga. Oku Yesu agenda ha bugenyi bw’amaani obw’okuswerwa, kandi akora ekyamahano kye eky’okubanza. Omanyire nikiha? Ahindura amaizi agafoora amaarwa.Matayo 3:13-17; 4:1-11; 13:55; Marako 6:3; Yohana 1:29-51; 2:1-12. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

MALI hanu Yesu nazooka abihiirwe. Tinukwo? Omanyire habwaki abihiirwe muno? Habw’okuba abasaija banu abali mu yekaru ya Ruhanga mu Yerusalemu b’omururu mwingi. Nibalengaho okutunga sente nyingi kuruga mu bantu abaizire kuramya Ruhanga.

Norora ezo enimi ento zoona n’entaama hamu n’amaiba goona? Mali abasaija nibabitundira hanu mu yekaru. Nomanya habwaki? Habw’okuba Abaisareri nibetaaga ebisoro n’ebinyonyi kuhongera Ruhanga.

Ekiragiro kya Ruhanga kikaba nikigamba ngu Omuisareri obu arakoraga ekibi, akaba asemerire kuhayo ekihongwa hali Ruhanga. Kandi hakaba haroho n’obusumi obundi Abaisareri obu baali baina kuhayo ebihongwa. Baitu Omuisareri akaba nasobora kwiha nkaha ebinyonyi n’ebisoro eby’okuhongera Ruhanga?

Abaisareri abamu bali baine amatungo g’ebinyonyi n’ebisoro. Kale bakaba nibasobora kuhonga binu. Baitu Abaisareri baingi bakaba bataine bisoro rundi binyonyi byona. Kandi abandi baikaraga hara muno na yekaru batakusobora kuleta mu yekaru ha bisoro byabu. Kale nu abantu baijaga kandi baguraga ebisoro rundi ebinyonyi ebi bayetagaga. Baitu abasaija banu basabaga abantu sente nyingi. Babanyaga abantu. Kandi n’ekindi, tibasemerire kuba nibabitundira hanu mu yekaru ya Ruhanga.

Kinu nikyo kyaletiire Yesu kukwatwa ekiniga. Hati nikwo uwe kujumika emeza z’abasaija ezikaba ziroho sente kandi n’okurarangya sente zaabu. Akakora orujunju rw’obuguha, kandi yabinga ebisoro byoona kuruga mu yekaru. Yaragira abasaija abakutunda amaiba: ‘Muturukye binu! Mulekere aho kuhindura enju ya Ise nyowe ekiikaro ky’okukora amagoba maingi.’

Abamu ha begeswa ba Yesu bakaba hanu mu yekaru omu Yerusalemu. Bakahunirra habw’ebi barozire Yesu nakora. Hati baijuka nambere Baibuli erukugamba ha mwana wa Ruhanga: ‘Okugonza enju ya Ruhanga kulyaka nk’omurro muluwe.’

Yesu akyali hanu mu Yerusalemu ha bugenyi by’okuhingurwaho, akora ebyamahano bingi. Hanyuma aruga Buyudaaya akwata omuhanda kugaruka Galiraya. Obu akaba nagarukayo araba mu bicweka bya Samaliya. Leka turole biki ebyabaireyo.Yohana 2:13-25; 4:3, 4. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YESU ayemeriire kuhumuraho haiziba eriri mu Samaliya. Abegeswa be bakaba bagenzere murubuga kugura ebyokulya. Omukazi Yesu ou arukubaza nawe aizire kutaha amaizi. Yamugamba: ‘Mpa amaizi nyweho.’

Kinu kikahuniriza muno omukazi ogu. Omanyire habwaki? Habw’okuba Yesu Muyudaya kandi omukazi Musamaliya. Kandi Abayudaya abakukira obwingi tibagonza Abasamaliya. N’okubaza tibabaza nabo! Baitu Yesu agonza abantu ba buli mulingo. Kale nubwo yagamba: ‘Kakuba nomanya arukukusaba amaizi kunywa, wakumusabire kandi akakuhaire amaizi agarukuleta obwomezi.’

Omukazi agamba ati: ‘Waitu, iziba riraihire kandi tonyina eky’okutahisa. Hati noija kwiha nkaha amaizi ganu agarukuleta obwomezi?’

Yesu amusoborra: ‘Kuba onywa amaizi ag’iziba linu oija kugaruka kukwatwa iroho, baitu amaizi agandakuha nigaletera omuntu kwomera ebiro byoona.’

Omukazi amugamba ati: ‘Waitu, mpa amaizi ganu! Nukwo tindukwija kukwatwa iroho obundi. Kandi tikirukwija kunyetagisa kwija hanu kutaha amaizi omurundi ogundi.’

Omukazi natekereza ngu Yesu nagamba h’amaizi gonyini. Baitu uwe nagamba ha mananu agarukukwata ha Ruhanga naha Bukama bwe. Amananu ganu nigasisana n’amaizi agarukuleta obwomezi. Nigasobora kuha omuntu obwomezi obutahwaho.

Hati Yesu agambira omukazi ati: ‘Genda oyete baro kandi ogaruke.’

Omukazi amugarukamu ati: ‘Tinyina iba nyowe.’

Yesu agamba ati: ‘Ogarukiremu ekihikire. Baitu okatunga abasaija bataano, kandi omusaija owoli nawe hati tali baro.’

Omukazi ahunirra, habw’okuba binu byoona by’amananu. Baitu Yesu akamanya ata ebintu binu? Mali kiri nti Yesu Nuwe Ayanihiziibwe, ayatumirwe Ruhanga, kandi Ruhanga nuwe yamumanyisize binu. Ha bwire bunu, abegeswa ba Yesu bagaruka, kandi bahunirra kusanga Yesu nabaza n’omukazi Omusamaliya.

Kiki ekiturukwega mu binu byona? Nikyoleka ngu Yesu aine embabazi hali abantu ab’enganda zoona. Naitwe nukwo tusemerire kuba. Titusemerire kutekereza ngu abantu abamu babi habw’okuba nibaruga mu ruganda orumu. Yesu nayenda abantu boona bamanye amananu agarukuhikya ha bwomezi obutahwaho. Kandi naitwe tusemerire kukonyera abantu kwega amananu.Yohana 4:5-43; 17:3. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA Yesu aikaliire hanu. Nayegesa abantu banu boona ha rusozi mu Galiraya. Abo abamwikalire haihi begeswa be. Akomere mu bo 12 okuba abakwenda be. Abakwenda bali abegeswa be ab’embaganiza. Omanyire amabara gabu?

Haroho Simoni Petero na mugenziwe Andereya. Haroho Yakobo na Yohana, nabo nyinemu. Omukwenda ondi nawe ayetwa Yakobo kandi nondi ayetwa Simoni. Abakwenda babiri nibetwa Yuda. Omu nuwe Yuda Isikalyota kandi Yuda oli ondi obundi ayetwa Tadeo. Hanyuma haroho Firipo kandi na Nasaneri (obundi ayetwa Baturumayo), na Matayo na Tomasi.

Obu yagarukire kuruga Samalia, murundi gw’okubanza Yesu akatandika kwegesa ati: ‘Obukama bw’omwiguru bwirire haihi.’ Omanyire obukama nikyo kiki? Nibwo bulemi bwonyini obwa Ruhanga. Yesu nuwe Mukama wabwo. Aija kulema ali mu iguru kandi aija kuleta obusinge ha nsi. Obukama bwa Ruhanga nibwija kuhindura ensi yoona kuba orugonjo orurungi muno.

Yesu hanu nayegesa abantu ha bukama. Nabasoborra: ‘Kunu nukwo musabege muti, Isitwe ali omu iguru, ibara lyawe dyezebwe. Obukama bwawe bwije. Ebyogonza bikorwe mu nsi nkoku bikorwa omu iguru.’ Enu abantu baingi bagyeta ‘Esara ya Mukama waitu.’ Abandi bagyeta ‘esara eya Isitwe.’ Osobora kugarukamu esara enu yoona? Yesu kandi nayegesa abantu nkoku basemerire kutwazangana. Akagamba: ‘Korraga abandi nkoku orukwenda bakukorrege.’ Tosemererwa abandi obu bakutwaza n’embabazi? Kale, Yesu nagamba ngu tusemerire kutwaza abantu abandi n’embabazi. Tikikwija kuba kirungi obu buli muntu aliba naakora ati mu rugonjo rwa Ruhanga omu nsi?Matayo suura 5 kuhika 7; Matayo 10:1-4. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OMWISIKI onu ow’orukurora hanu aine emyaka 12. Yesu akwasire omukono gwe, kandi nyina na ise bemeriire haihi. Nomanya habwaki nibazooka basemeriirwe muno? Katukizoole.

Ise omwisiki musaija w’ekitiinisa arukwetwa Yairo. Kiro kimu, omuhara we akarwara, kandi bamubyamya. Baitu tiyasobora kuba kurungi. Akaikara nasereba. Yairo n’omukyara we bakeralikirra muno habw’okuba omwisiki wabo omuto nagenda kufa. Nuwe mwana wabo ow’obuhara ou baine. Yairo nukwo kugenda kuseerra Yesu. Akaba amanyisibwe ha by’amahano Yesu eby’arukukora.

Yairo obu yazoire Yesu, yasanga ekitebe ky’abantu kigomere kimwehingulirize. Baitu Yairo abarabamu kandi agwa ha bigere bya Yesu. Agamba: ‘Omwana wange murwaire muno. Nkwesengerize ija omukize.’ Yesu agamba ngu naija kwija.

Obu baba nibarubatira hamu, ekitebe ky’abantu basindikangana kumwirra haihi. Ahonaho, Yesu ayemerra. Akaguza: ‘Noha ankwasireho?’ Yesu akahurra amaani nigamurugamu, nukwo akimanya ngu haroho amukwasireho. Baitu noha? N’omukazi ataaha arwaire kumara emyaka 12. Nuwe yaizire hali Yesu kandi yakwata ha ngoye ze, kandi yakizibwa!

Kinu kihumuza Yairo habw’okuba arozere nkoku kyanguhire Yesu okukiza omuntu. Baitu omuntu omutumwa aija. Agambira Yairo ati: ‘Oteyongera kutalibaniza Yesu; omwana wawe afiire.’ Yesu ahurra ebigambo binu kandi agambira Yairo ati: ‘Otatiina, naija kuba kurungi.’

Hanyuma obu bamara kuhika ha nju ya Yairo, abantu baba nibarra n’okusalirwa kwingi. Baitu Yesu abagamba: ‘Muleke kurra. Omwana tafiire, abyamire bubyama.’ Baitu baseka, kandi basekereza Yesu, habw’okuba bamanyire ngu afiire.

Aho Yesu atwara ise na nyina w’omwisiki n’abasatu h’abakwenda be mukisiika nambere omwisiki abyamire. Akwata omukono gwe kandi agamba: ‘Imuka!’ Omwisiki agaruka kuba mwomezi, nkoku orukurora hanu. Kandi ayimuka atandika n’okurubatarubata! Niyo nsonga habwaki nyina na ise basemeriirwe muno.

Onu talinuwe omuntu ow’okubanza Yesu kuhumbuura omu bafu. Ow’okubanza Baibuli ow’egambaho nuwe omutabani w’omufakati ayaikaraga mu rubuga rwa Naini. Hanyuma, Yesu ahumbuura Lazaro, munyanya wa Malyamu na Maliza. Yesu obu alirema nk’omukama ateirweho Ruhanga, naija kuhumbuura abantu baingi. Tikituhikiriire kusemererwa habw’ekyo?Luka 8:40-56; 7:11-17; Yohana 11:17-44. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

EKINTU ekibi muno kibaireho. Yohana Omubatizi amazire kwitwa. Herodiya, muka omukama akaba atakumugonza. Kandi akasobora kuletera omukama kuragira Yohana kutemwaho omutwe.

Yesu bw’ahurra binu, asalirwa muno. Ayehuguraho kuba wenka. Baitu abantu bamusangayo. Yesu obwarora ekitebe ky’abantu, abakwatirwa embabazi. Abatebeza ha Bukama bwa Ruhanga, kandi akiza abarwaire babo.

Rwebagyo oru abageswa be baija haluwe kandi bagamba: ‘Obwire bugenzere, kandi ekicweka kinu tikirumu bantu. Ragira abantu bagende begurre ebyokulya mubyaro haihi.’

Yesu abagarukamu: ‘Tikikwetagisa bo kugenda. Inywe mubahe ekyokulya.’ Ahindukira Firipo amukaguza ati: ‘Nitusobora kugura nkaha ebyokulya ebikumara kuliisa abantu banu boona?’

Firipo agarukamu ati: ‘Kiija kutwara sente nyingi muno kugura eby’okulya ebikumara nukwo buli omu atungeho kake.’ Andereya nawe agamba ati: ‘Onu omwojo ahimbiire eby’okulya, aine emigaati etaano kandi n’encu ibiri. Baitu binu tibirukwija kumara abantu banu boona.’

Yesu agamba: ‘Gambira abantu baikarre hansi ha bunyansi.’ Aho Yesu asiima Ruhanga habw’ebyokulya kandi atandika kubicwamucwamu. Hanyuma abegeswa be bagabira abantu boona emigaati n’encu. Hakaba haroho abasaija 5,000 kandi otaireho enkumi n’enkumi z’abakazi n’abaana. Boona balya kuhikya obu baigusire. Kandi abegeswa obu basoroize obukunkumuka bwijuza ebigega12!

Yesu hati agamba abegeswa be kugenda mu ryato nukwo bacwanganize Enyanja ya Galilaya. Mu kiro omuyaga gw’amaani gwaija, kandi ebigonzi bitwara eryato hanu na hali. Abegeswa batiina muno. Hagati y’ekiro, barora omuntu naija halibo ha maizi. Bakunga n’okutiina, habw’okuba batetegereze eki bakaba nibarora.

Yesu agamba: ‘Mutatiina, niinye!’ Nabwo batakikirize. Hati Petero agamba ati: ‘Mali obworaba niiwe, Mukama, ngambira nanye ndubate h’amaizi nyije h’oli.’ Yesu amugarukamu ati: ‘Ija!’ Kandi Petero aruga mu ryato kandi arubatira h’amaizi! Baitu hanyuma atiina kandi atandika kudikira, baitu Yesu amujuna.

Hanyumaho Yesu ayeyongera aliisa enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu. Murundi gunu akakozesa emigati etaano n’obucu buke. Nabyo bimara boona. Tikiri kyamahano nkoku Yesu arukufayo h’abantu? Obu aliba nalema nk’Omukama atairweho Ruhanga titulyeralikirra ekintu kyoona!Matayo 14:1-32; 15:29-38; Yohana 6:1-21. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA hanu Yesu abumbatiire omwojo omuto. Nosobora kurora nkoku Yesu arukufayo hali abato. Abasaija abarukubarolerra bakwenda be. Yesu nabagambira ki? Katukirole.

Yesu n’abakwenda be baakaruga murugendo oruraira. Mu muhanda abakwenda batungire empaka hagati yabo. Hanyuma y’orugendo Yesu abakaguza: ‘Kiki ekimubaire nimuhakanaho mu muhanda?’ Mananu, uwe Yesu akaba amanyire ekibakaba nibahakanaho. Baitu akaguza kurora abakwenda obu barasobora kumugambira.

Abakwenda tibamugarukamu, habwokuba mu muhanda babaire nibahakanira obukuru. Abakwenda abamu nibenda ekitiinisa ekirukukira ha ky’abandi. Yesu yakubagambiire ata ngu tikihire kugonza kuba w’ekitiinisa kukira abandi?

Ayeeta akoojo kandi akemereza hagati yabu boona. Hati nukwo agamba abegesebwa be: ‘Ninyenda mumanye kinu. Mu mananu, kakuba mutahinduka mukaba nk’abaana abato, timulisobora kutaaha mubukama bwa Ruhanga. Omuntu arukukirayo mubukama nuwe afooka nk’omwana onu.’ Omanyire habwaki Yesu yagambire kinu?

Mali abaana abato muno tibafayo noha arukukirayo rundi aine ekitiinisa okira abandi. Kale nu, abakwenda basemerire kwega kuba nk’abaana mumulingo gunu, kandi tibasemerire kukunganira obukuru rundi ekitiinisa.

Haroho n’emirundi endi nambere Yesu yayolekere ngu nafayo h’abaana abato. Emyezi emike obu yahingwireho, abantu abamu bakaleta abaana babu kurora Yesu. Abakwenda bakalengaho kubahinda kwija haliwe. Baitu Yesu yagamba abakwendabe: ‘Muleke abaana baije hali nyowe kandi mutabatanga, habwokuba obukama bwa Ruhanga buli bwa abali nk’abo.’ Nukwo Yesu kukwata abaana mu mikono ye, kandi boona yabaha emigisa. Tikiri kirungi kumanya ngu Yesu nagonza abaana abato?Matayo 18:1-4; 19:13-15; Marako 9:33-37; 10:13-16. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

KIRO kimu Yesu agambira omusaija ngu asemerire kugonza mutaahi we. Omusaija akaguza Yesu ati: ‘Mutaahi wange nuwe oha?’ Yesu mali amanyire omusaija onu okwarukutekereza. Omusaija natekereza ngu abantu ab’oruganda rwe n’ediini ye nubo bonka abataahi be. Katuzoole kiki Yesu eki yamugambiire.

Obundi n’obundi Yesu yayegesaga nakozesa oruganikyo. Hati nikyo akora. Agamba ha ruganikyo orurukukwata ha Muyudaya n’Omusamaliya. Tumazire kwega ngu Abayudaya abakukira obwingi tibaagonza Abasamaliya. Kale runu nurwo ruganikyo rwa Yesu:

Kiro kimu hakaba haroho Omuyudaya akaba na sirimuka mu muhanda ogw’orusozi kugenda Yeriko. Baitu abasuma bakamugurukira. Bakamwibaho sente ze kandi bamutera bamuleka nk’afiire.

Hanyuma, nyakatagara Omuyudaya akaija mu muhanda ogu. Yarora omusaija ayatiirwe. Notekereza akakora ata? Mali akacwanganiza orugudo yagenda harubaju orundi, yayegendera. Hanyuma omusaija ondi Omunyadiini nawe akaija. Akaba ali Mulevi. Akemerra? Nangwa, nawe atemerre kukonyera omusaija ayatiirwe. Nosobora kurora nyakatagara n’Omulevi nibasirimuka mumuhanda.

Baitu dora onu ali n’omusaija ayatiirwe. Musamaliya. Nakonyera Omuyudaya. Namutaho omubazi ha bihuta bye. Hanyuma akatwara Omuyudaya omukiikaro nambere asobora kuhumurraho akaba kurungi.

Hanyuma y’okumara oruganikyo runu, Yesu agamba omusaija ayamukagwize ekikaguzo: ‘Mubanu habasatu, noha ayayefoire nka mutaahi w’omusaija ayatiirwe? Nyakatagara, rundi Omulevi, rundi Omusamaliya?’

Omusaija agarukamu ati: ‘Omusamaliya. Akagirra embabazi omusaija ayatiirwe.’

Yesu agamba ati: ‘Ohikire. Kale genda okolege abandi nkoku ogu yakozere.’

Torukugonza omulingo Yesu ogu ayegesaamu? Tusobora kwega ebintu ebikuru kakuba tuhuliriza Yesu ebyakugamba mu Baibuli, tinukwo kiri?Luka 10:25-37. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YESU obwagenda mu nsi egi yoona, akiza abarwaire. Amakuru g’ebyamahano binu garanganwa mubyaro n’omubibuga okwehinguliriza. Nahabwekyo abantu bamuletera abalema, bakihimbara, bakiifa-matu kandi n’abandi baingi abakaba barwaire. Yesu abakiza boona.

Emyaka esatu ehingwireho okuruga obu Yohana abatiza Yesu. Kandi Yesu agambira abakwenda be ngu akasumi kali haihi uwe naija kugenda Yerusalemu, h’alitirwa, kandi amale ahumbuuke kuruga mu bafu. Binu bitakabaireho, Yesu ayeyongera kukiza abarwaire.

Kiro kimu, Yesu akaba nayegesa ha Sabiiti. Sabiiti kiro ky’okuhumu’raho hali Abayudaya. Omukazi ow’okurora hanu abaire murwaire muno. Kumara emyaka 18 abaire agongobaire, atasobora kwemerra kurungi. Nahabwekyo, Yesu amutekaho omukono gwe kandi atandika kwemerra. Akizire!

Kinu kiretera abakuru b’ediini kubihirwa. Omu halibo agamba natoka hali ekitebe ky’abantu: ‘Haroho ebiro mukaaga kukorramu emirimo. Ebi nibyo ebiro mwizirehoga kukizibwa, baitu hatali ha kya Sabiiti!’

Baitu Yesu amugarukamu ati: ‘Inywe abasaija ababi. Buli omu halinywe nasumurra endogoyi ye nagitwara ha maizi kunywa ha Sabiiti. Kale nu tikisemerire omukazi onu anyakubaire murwaire kumara emyaka 18 kukizibwa ha Sabiiti?’ Okugarukamu kunu okwa Yesu kuletera abasaija banu ababi kuswaara.

Hanyuma Yesu n’abakwenda be barubata nibagenda Yerusalemu. Obu bahikire aheru y’orubuga rwa Yeriko, bakihimbaara babiri abaasabirizaga baahu’ra ngu narabaho. Nubwo batoka: ‘Yesu, tukonyere!’

Yesu ayeta abasaija banu bakihimbaara mumaiso kwija nambere ali, kandi abakaguza: ‘Nimwenda mbakorre ki?’ Bagamba: ‘Mukama, amaiso gaitu garole.’ Yesu akwata ha maiso gaabo kandi ahonaho batandika kurora! Nomanya habwaki Yesu nakora ebyamahano binu byoona ebirungi? Habwokuba nagonza abantu, kandi nagonza bamwikiririzemu. Kandi naitwe tusobora kukigumya ngu obwaliba nalema nk’Omukama, busaho n’omu hansi aliba murwaire obundi.Matayo 15:30, 31; Luka 13:10-17; Matayo 20:29-34. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

HANYUMA obu yamazire kukiza abasabiriza babiri abakaba bakihimbaara, Yesu yaija ha kaaro akali haihi na Yerusalemu. Yagambira babiri h’abegeswabe: ‘Mugende mukyaro ekyo kandi murasanga enkaina ento. Mugisumurre, mugindetere.’

Enkaina obu yaleserwe hali we, Yesu agikarraho. Agigenderaho kuhika Yerusalemu orugendo orukaba rugufu. Obu yahikire haihi n’orubuga, ekitebe ky’abantu baingi kyaija kumutangana. Baingi halibo bejuura eminagiro yabu bagyarra mu muhanda. Abandi batema amataagi g’emiti y’emikindo. Nago bagarra mu muhanda kandi bakungira haiguru bati: ‘Ruhanga ahe omugisa omukama arukwizira mwibara lya Yahwe!’

Mubusumi bwakara mu Isareri abakama abahyaka bagenderaga ha nkaina ento kutaaha mu Yerusalemu nukwo beyoleke abantu. Kinu nikyo Yesu arukukora. Kandi abantu banu niboleka ngu nibagonza Yesu kuba mukama wabu. Baitu tibali boona abakumugonza. Nitwetegereza kinu kuruga ha byabaireho Yesu obu yagenzire mu yekaru.

Mu Yekaru, Yesu akiza bakihimbaara n’abalema. Abaana abato obu barozire binu, batokera haiguru nibahaisaniza Yesu. Baitu kinu kiretera banyakatagara kubihirwa kandi bagamba Yesu bati: ‘Nohurra abaana ebibarukugamba?’

Yesu abagarukamu ati: ‘Ego nimbihurra. Timukasomaga mu byahandikirwe nambere harukugamba: Omukanwa k’abaana abato Ruhanga naija kuleta okukugiza?’ Kale abaana beyongera kukugiza omukama ayatairweho Ruhanga.

Twakugondeze kuba nk’abaana abo, tinukwo? Abantu abamu basobora kulengaho okututanga kutebeza ha bukama bwa Ruhanga. Baitu nitwija kweyongera kutebeza abandi ha bintu ebirungi Yesu ebyarukwija kukorra abantu.

Yesu obu akaba ali hansi hanu, obwire bw’okutandika kulema nk’omukama bukaba butakahikire. Obwire bunu bulihika di? Abegeswa ba Yesu nibagonza kumanya. Nitwija kusoma ha kinu mubikugarukaho.Matayo 21:1-17; Yohana 12:12-16. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ONU nuwe Yesu ha rusozi rwa zeituni. Abasaija bbana abali nawe bakwenda be. Nibo Andereya na mugenzi we Petero, kandi na Yakobo na mugenzi we Yohana. Egyo ey’orukurora nseri ni yekaru ya Ruhanga mu Yerusalemu. Hahingwireho ebiro bibiri kuruga Yesu ataaha mu Yerusalemu atembere enkaina ento. Kiri Kyakabiri. Nyenkya kara ekiro ekyo Yesu akaba ali mu yekaru. Oku banyakatagara bakalengaho kumukwata n’okumwita. Baitu bakatiina kukora kinu habwokuba abantu bagonza Yesu.

‘Inywe enjoka kandi abaana b’enjoka!’ Yesu nukwo yayesere abakuru b’ediini abo. Nubwo yesu abagamba ngu Ruhanga naija kubafubira habw’ebibi ebyo byona ebi bakozere. Hanyuma yebyo Yesu yatemba ha Rusozi rwa zeituni, kandi nubwo abakwendabe banu abbana batandika kumukaguza ebikaguzo. Omanyire eki barukukaguza Yesu?

Abakwenda nibakaguza ha biribaho mubwire bw’omu maiso. Bamanyire ngu Yesu naija kumarraho kimu obubi bwoona hansi. Baitu nibagonza bamanye ddi kinu obukiribaho. Yesu aligaruka ddi kulema nk’Omukama?

Yesu akimanyire ngu abakurasibe be ab’omu nsi tibalisobora kumurora obwaligaruka. Kinu kiri kiti habwokuba uwe aliba mwiguru, kandi tibalisobora kumurora haali. Nahabwekyo, Yesu agambira abakwenda be ebimu ha bintu ebiribaho omu nsi obwaliba nalema nk’omukama omwiguru. Ebimu hali binu nibyo biha?

Yesu agamba ngu halibaho obulemu bw’amaani, abantu baingi baliba barwaire, kandi baliba n’enjara, obwemi buliba bwingi, kandi halibaho emisisa y’amaani. Yesu ayongera agamba ngu amakuru amarungi agarukukwata ha bukama bwa Ruhanga galitebezebwa munsi yoona. Titurukurora ebintu binu nibihikirizibwa mu busumi bwaitu? Ego mali! Ego nitusobora kukigumya ngu Yesu hati nalema omwiguru. Bwangu naija kwihaho obubi bwoona omu nsi.Matayo 21:46; 23:1-39; 24:1-14; Marako 13:3-10. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

HATI Kyakana bwire bw’ekiro, hahingwireho biro bibiri. Yesu n’abakwenda be 12 baizire mu kisiika kinu ekikooto eky’ahaiguru kulya ekiihuro ky’okuhingurwaho. Omusaija ow’orukurora nabarugaho ni Yuda Isikalyota. Nagenda kugambira banyakatagara nkoku basobora kukwata Yesu.

Ekiro Kyakasatu, Yuda akaba agenzere halibo kandi yabakaguza: ‘Murampaki kakuba mbakonyera kukwata Yesu?’ Bamugamba bati: ‘Nitwija kukuha ebicweka by’efeeza makumi asatu.’ Hati bunu Yuda nagenda kutangana abasaija banu nukwo abebembere kubahikya hali Yesu. Kinu tikiri kintu kibi muno?

Ekiihuro ky’Okuhingurwaho kihoire. Baitu hati Yesu atandika ekiihuro ekindi eky’embaganiza. Ahereza bakwenda be omugaati kandi abagamba ati: ‘Mugulye, habwokuba gunu nigumanyisa omubiri gwange ogukugenda kuhebwayo habwanyu.’ Nubwo yagaruka yabahereza empwahwa kandi yagamba: ‘Munywe, habwokuba kinu nikimanyisa esagama yange, erukwija kuseseka habwanyu.’ Baibuli eyeta kinu, ‘Ekiihuro kya Mukama waitu eky’orwebagyo,’ rundi ‘Eky’ekiro kya Mukama waitu.’

Abaisareri balyaga ekiihuro ky’Okuhingurwaho kubaijukya maraika wa Ruhanga obu ‘yahingura’ hamaju gaabu mu Misiri, baitu akaita emizigaijo mu maka g’Abamisiri. Baitu hati Yesu nagonza abegeswa be kumwijukaga n’oku yahaireyo obwomezi bwe habwabo. Niyo nsonga habwaki yabagambira kukuza ekiihuro kinu eky’embaganiza buli mwaka.

Hanyuma y’okulya Ekiihuro kya Mukama waitu eky’Orwebagyo, Yesu agambira abakwenda be kuba bamanzi nab’amaani mukwikiriza. Hakumalirra bazinira Ruhanga ebizina kandi baturuka baruga aho. Hati obwire bugenzere, haihi kuhingura saaha mukaga ez’omwitumbi. Katurole ha baagenzere.Matayo 26:14-30; Luka 22:1-39; Yohana suura 13 kuhika 17; 1 Abakolinso 11:20. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OBU barugire omu kisiika eky’ahaiguru, Yesu n’abegeswa be bakagenda omu musiri ogwa Gesesemane. Hanu bakaba baraizireho emirundi nyingi. Yesu hati abagambira ngu baikale nibarora kandi nibasaba. Agendaho akaanya kake, ateeza amaju hansi, ainama, atandika okusaba.

Hanyuma, aija hali abegeswa be nambere akaba abalekere. Nomanya kiki eki baali nibakora? Boona bakaba bagwijagiire! Yesu amara emirundi esatu nabaijukya okwikara bulindaara, baitu obu yagarukaga yabasangaga bagwijagire. ‘Musobora muta kugwijagira mubwire nka bunu?’ Omurundi ogw’ahampero Yesu obu yagarukire akagamba ati: ‘Dora akasumi kamalize kuhika okuhebwayo hati omu mikono y’abanyanzigwa bange.’

Mukanya ako, etoko y’abantu abangi ekaba n’ehulirwa. Dora! Abasaija baizire n’empirima n’ebigo! Kandi bakaba bakwasire ebimuli by’omu’ro kubaha ekyererezi. Obu baizire haihi, omuntu omu aruga hagati y’abantu, airra haihi na Yesu. Amunywegera nkoku orukurora hanu. Omuntu onu niwe Yuda Isekalyota! Habwaki yanywegera Yesu?

Yesu amukaguza: ‘Yuda, nongobeza n’okunywegera?’ Mali okunywegera kaali kokurorraho. Nikamanyisa abasaija aba Yuda yaizire nabo ou Yesu ali. Nahabwekyo abanyanzigwa ba Yesu bamukwata. Kyonka Petero tarukwenda kuleka abanyanzigwa kutwara Yesu atamurwanirire. Asomorayo busitama ye ei akaba aizire nayo, atema omusaija ou akaba ali haihi nawe. Aburwaho kake kumutemaho omutwe kyonka akwasa okutu kw’obulyo. Baitu Yesu akwata okutu kw’omusaija n’okumukiza.

Yesu agambira Petero ati: ‘Empirima yawe ogigarurre omu kiraaro kyayo. Notekereza oti tindukusobora kusaba ise nyowe okumpa hati bamu habamaraika okunkonyera?’ Ego nasobora. Baitu Yesu atasabe Ruhanga kumuha bamaraika habwokuba akaba amanyire obwire bw’abanyanzigwa be bukaba buhikire kumutwara. Nukwo kuleka bakamutwara. Hati katurole kiki ekyabaireho hali Yesu.Matayo 26:36-56; Luka 22:39-53; Yohana 18:1-12. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA ekintu ekibi muno ekiroho! Yesu naitwa. Bamuhanikire ha muti. Emisumali etiirwe mu mikono ye n’omubigere bye. Habwaki omuntu weena yakukozere Yesu ekintu nka kinu?

Nahabwokuba abantu abamu banobere Yesu. Omanyire nibo baha? Omu halibo ni maraika omubi Setani Diabolo. Nuwe yaletiire Adamu na Hawa kujemera Yahwe. Kandi na Setani nuwe yaletiire abanyanzigwa ba Yesu kukora ekikorwa kinu ekibi muno.

Na Yesu obwakaba atakahanikirwe ha muti hanu, abanyanzigwa be bakamukora ebintu ebindi ebirukusaaliza. Noijuka nkoku baizire murugonjo Gesesamane kandi bakamutwara? Abanyanzigwa abo bakaba bali baaha? Mali bakaba bali abakuru b’ediini. Kale katurole ebyakurasireho.

Yesu obu yatwairwe abakuru b’ediini, abakwenda be bakamwirukaho. Bakaleka Yesu ali wenka n’abanyanzigwa be, habwokuba bakatiina. Baitu abakwenda Petero na Yohana bo batagende hara. Bakahondera kurora kiki ekirahika hali Yesu.

Abanyakatagara bakatwara Yesu hali omugurusi Ana, ayabaireho nyakatagara omukuru. Ekitebe ky’abantu kitaikale muno hanu. Hanyuma batwara Yesu munju ya Kayafa, hati ali nyakatagara omukuru. Abakuru b’ediini baingi bateraniire munju ye.

Hanu munju ya Kayafa batekaho orukurato rw’okumujunana. Abantu abokubihirra Yesu baletebwa. Abakuru b’ediini boona bagamba bati: ‘Yesu esemerire kwitwa.’ Nubwo bamucwera ebicwanta mu maiso, kandi bamuteera n’entomi.

Binu byona obubikaba nibigenda mu maiso, Petero akaba ali aheru omuzigati. Kiro ky’obutiti, kandi nikyo abantu bahembeire omu’ro. Obu bakaba niboota omu’ro, omuzaana arora Petero kandi agamba ati: ‘Onu omusaija nawe abaire na Yesu.’

‘Nangwa, timbaire nawe!’ Petero ayehakana.

Emirundi esatu abantu bagamba ngu Petero akaba ali hamu na Yesu. Baitu buli murundi, Petero ayehakana. Omurundi gw’akasatu Petero obu yagambire kinu, Yesu ahinduka kandi amurora. Petero akwatwa ensoni habw’okugamba ebisuba binu, kandi arugaho arra.

Izooba obu lyaturukire ha Kyakatano nyenka kara, banyakatagara batwara Yesu mu mukisiika kyabu eky’okuteraniramu. Hanu babazaho ekibaragenda kumukora. Bamutwara owa Pontio Pilato omulemi w’ekicweka kya Buyudaya.

‘Onu musaija mubi. Asemerire kwitwa.’ Abanyakatagara baba nukwo bagambira Pilato. Hanyuma y’okukaguza Yesu ebikaguzo, Pilato agamba ati: ‘Tinkurora kibi kyona ekyakozere.’ Hanyuma Pilato atuma batwale Yesu owa Herode Antipa. Herode nuwe mulemi wa Galiraya, baitu naikara Yerusalemu. Nawe Herode tarukurora ekintu kyona eki Yesu asobeze, nahabwekyo, atuma bamugarrayo owa Pilato.

Pilato nayenda kusumurra Yesu. Baitu abanyanzigwa ba Yesu nibagonza omunyankomo ondi nuwe asumururwe mukiikaro kye. Omusaija onu nuwe Baraba omunyagi. Hati ziri haihi saaha mukaaga eza nyamusana Pilato bwaleta Yesu aheru. Agambira abantu ati: ‘Dora! Omukama Wanyu!’ Baitu banyakatagara n’abakuru batokera haiguru: ‘Mwiheho! Mwite! Mwite!’ Nukwo Pilato asumurra Baraba, kandi batwara Yesu aitibwe.

Karaho Kyakatano mwihangwe Yesu ahanikibwa ha muti. Tosobora kubarora mukisisani, baitu buli rubaju rwa Yesu haroho omunyabibi ahanikirwe ha muti. Akasumi kake atakafiire, omu hali banu amugambira: ‘Onyijuke obwolitaaha mu bukama bwawe.’ Kandi Yesu amugarukamu ati: ‘Ninkunihiza ngu oliba nanyowe mu Rugonjo.’

Oku tikuli kunihiza kurungi? N’omanya orugonjo Yesu arwarukugambaho? Orugonjo Ruhanga oru yakozire mukutandika rukaba ruri nkaha? Mali omu nsi. Kandi obu aliba nalema nk’omukama w’omwiguru, alihumbuura omusaija onu asemerererwe omu rugonjo omu nsi. Naitwe titusemeriire kusemererwa habwekyo?Matayo 26:57-75; 27:1-50; Luka 22:54-71; 23:1-49; Yohana 18:12-40; 19:1-30. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega
